title: Slow Momentum with Fast Reversion: A Trading Strategy Using Deep Learning and Changepoint Detection

extraction.methodology_summary: An online changepoint detection (CPD) module based on Gaussian Process regression with a Matern 3/2 and Changepoint kernel is integrated into a Deep Momentum Network (DMN) pipeline using an LSTM architecture. The CPD module outputs a changepoint location and severity score, which are passed as inputs alongside returns and MACD indicators to train the LSTM network. The network directly optimizes a Sharpe ratio loss function via mini-batch SGD to learn trend estimation, regime changes, and position sizing.
extraction.universe: 50 liquid, continuous futures contracts across commodities, equities, fixed income, and FX

key_findings: Integrating an online changepoint detection (CPD) module into Deep Momentum Networks (DMNs) improves the Sharpe ratio by approximately one-third across the 1995-2020 back-test period.

The CPD module is especially beneficial during periods of significant nonstationarity, achieving a performance boost of approximately two-thirds over the 2015-2020 period where traditional momentum strategies underperformed.
Using Gaussian Processes for CPD enables the model to perform well even with short lookback window (LBW) lengths such as two weeks, with performance peaking around a one-month LBW.
The CPD module helps reduce risk metrics like volatility, downside deviation, and maximum drawdown while slightly increasing raw returns, leading to a more robust model during market crashes.
limitations: The primary back-tests focus on raw predictive power and do not account for transaction costs, though transaction cost analysis indicates the strategy outperforms classical strategies for average transaction costs up to 2 basis points.
Larger CPD lookback windows become more favorable when higher transaction costs are introduced.
